text:
To the Moon Dental clinic is one of my all time favorites!!!!!
I am Korean traveler. While traveling in Bangkok, my tooth suddenly started hurting,
I was looking for dentists on the internet and happened to visit this dentist.
I am not a doctor, but as someone who has run two hospitals in Korea(My family business), I have the tools to judge customer service, interior design, and everything else with a different insight than the average person.
This dental clinic is cozy,  clean, and has modern equipment.
The representative dentist is very conscientious and considers the patient's point of view, which is hard to find these days. She provides counseling for the patient as if the parents were thinking about their children.
It's a shame it's only five stars. My personal score is 100 stars. I highly recommend travelers like me to go to this dentist for consultation if they have any problems with their teeth in Bangkok.
